I added the three features to `Shop.Cart` in `lib/shop/cart.ex`, with tests. The project compiles with no warnings, Credo (a code-style checker) reports no issues, and all 18 tests pass, including 3 that run the code examples in the docs.

- **Removing items:** `remove_item(cart, sku, quantity)` takes units off an item. Removing as many units as the cart holds, or more, drops the item. Removing an item that isn't in the cart leaves the cart unchanged.
